desc: Derive the game-theoretic characterization of winning and losing positions based on the multiset of \(A_i\).
Determine how duplicate values and value gaps affect which player can force the final new index to be claimed.
Formulate an \(O(N)\) algorithm using parity/counting and small-\(N\) cases.
Prove correctness through the reduced delay-move state recurrence.
Implement the algorithm in Python with stdin/stdout handling.
